decision.observation: This dark wire orb differs from the pale woven orbs—dark metal/wire material with a golden seed-pod knob on a curved arm at its top-right (~x890,y380) and a wooden stick propped at its lower-left. Hornet stands beside the stick. A large flat mushroom cap at right (~x960,y460).
